candidate.title: Duplex-Seq
candidate.scope: The middle row labeled Duplex-Seq in the assigned Illumina poster crop: the tagged, two-strand DNA error-correction architecture identified in the supplied Schmitt et al. (2012) abstract as Duplex Sequencing. Adjacent Safe-SeqS, snmC-Seq and the partial flow-cell workflow are context, not alternatives or connected branches of this card. Scope is the depicted adapter/PCR-to-duplex-supported variant workflow, not every implementation of the assay or the paper's applications. The existing two-strand mutation icon is input description, not a mutation-induction operation. Independent strand lineages are logical branches, without an asserted physical separation.

operations.label: Add adapters; Ligate and PCR
operations.description: Supply the depicted alpha/beta index-bearing adapters to the DNA duplex, ligate adapters and amplify the tagged DNA. This grouped preparation block converts an untagged duplex into sequenceable tagged copies with distinguishable ancestry from its two original strands. Both source captions are retained; no unshown intermediate chemistry is supplied.
operations.mechanism: Adapter ligation followed by PCR, at the level of the source caption.
operations.information_effect: The adapter indexes become linked to the DNA insert, so repeated reads can be associated with original-strand families and paired back to the original duplex using tags and sequencing-primer identities.
